This applies to any Fell that went to the river door. Any Fell who went to the shaft is in [[05 - Down the Shaft|Down the Shaft]] or [[06 - The Grey Mother|The Grey Mother]].

> [!reminder] How this scene works
> Ten rafts, twenty Shrewish to a raft. The job here is to get the loading running properly, so that Dobb and his crew can keep sending rafts off on their own for the rest of the night. It takes two of the four things listed under Ways to get the loading running. A Success or a Fellmark on any of them counts. Once it is running, every raft is away before the root reaches the river door, whatever else happens. If it never gets running, Dobb gets six rafts away alone, and that matters at the end only if the shaft is neither sealed nor held. See The rafts in the overview.
> Partway through, the quay jolts and Dobb, who cannot swim, freezes. Whether the Fell bring him back changes only what he says at dawn.

> [!readaloud] Opening: The river door
> Through the arch at the end of the hall, a stone quay runs along the inside of the riverbank, with the river right there below it, black and fast, sliding past with a low hiss. Ten flat rafts are tied along the quay, each about the size of a door, with a rail around the edge and a row of little benches. Lamps are hung on poles at the corners. An old Shrewish with a pole across his shoulders walks up and down the quay, touching each raft as he passes it.

> [!dialogue] Dobb
> "Raft one, raft two, raft three. Twenty a raft. Sit down, stay down, no standing, no swapping, no going back for anything. Raft four. You're the big ones. Good. I need the rafts brought round to the steps one at a time and held there while they load, and I need it done steady, because if one of you rocks a raft with twenty in it, that's twenty in the river."

> [!dialogue] Dobb
> *If asked how long he's run the river:* "Thirty years. Thirty-one in the summer. Every raft that's gone out of this door has gone out with me counting it."

> [!dialogue] Dobb
> *If asked whether he can swim:* "Why would I need to swim? I've got rafts." *He doesn't look at them when he says it.*

> [!dialogue] Dobb
> *If asked where the rafts go:* "Down the Sallowrun to Quillbark Hold. Most of the night on the river. The current does the work. You just keep everybody sitting."

> [!readaloud] The first raft
> Dobb waves the first family down the steps. Then the next, and the next. They keep coming. By the time he looks up the first raft is sitting so low that water slops over the edge, and there are still five Shrewish trying to climb on.

> [!reminder] Ways to get the loading running
> The loading runs once two of these have gone right. Any Fell may try any one.
> - **Haul the rafts.** A Might roll brings them round to the steps and holds them steady.
> - **Steady the crowd.** A Presence roll gets the quay into a line and keeps it there.
> - **Catch the tipping raft,** when it comes. A Reflex roll.
> - **Steady Dobb,** when he freezes. A Spirit roll.
> If fewer than two go right, the loading never gets running properly. Dobb keeps sending rafts off by himself, slowly. Write down: the loading is not running.

> [!lorecheck] Might: Hauling the rafts
> Any Fell who takes a rope.
>
> - **Fellmark.** *Read:* You take the rope off the post and pull the next raft round against the current in one long pull. You hold it there, dead steady, while twenty Shrewish file on. Then the next one. Dobb stops counting long enough to stare at you. *Then:* One of the two ways is done. Their Might increases by 1.
> - **Success.** *Read:* The current fights you and you win. The raft comes round to the steps and stays. *Then:* One of the two ways is done.
> - **Failure.** *Read:* The rope burns through your hands and the raft swings out. Dobb gets it back with his pole. "Steady. Steady. Try again."
> - **Fellstrike.** *Read:* You haul too hard. The raft slams into the steps and everybody on it shrieks. Nobody falls in. Dobb takes the rope off you very politely.

> [!lorecheck] Presence: Steadying the crowd
> Any Fell who takes charge of the quay.
>
> - **Fellmark.** *Read:* You stand at the top of the steps where everyone can see you and you tell them what's happening, slowly, in a voice that carries. The pushing stops. They make a line. A few of them even sit down on their bundles and wait to board. *Then:* One of the two ways is done. Their Presence increases by 1.
> - **Success.** *Read:* You get them into something like a line. It holds. *Then:* One of the two ways is done.
> - **Failure.** *Read:* They hear you, nod, and keep pushing.
> - **Fellstrike.** *Read:* You shout. Everybody on the quay stops and stares up at you, and then they all start shouting back.

**This applies to a Shrewish Fell.** The crowd takes orders from one of their own more easily. A Shrewish Fell who steadies the crowd stands on Dobb's bucket to do it.

> [!beat] The quay jolts
> The stone of the quay jumps under everyone's feet. It is one sharp shock, and it comes from under the hall. A raft halfway loaded tips up on one side. Three Shrewish slide toward the rail and the black water. On the quay Dobb drops his pole and does not move.

> [!lorecheck] Reflex: Catching the raft
> Any Fell close enough to grab it. If nobody tries, the three Shrewish go into the river, and Dobb's crew fish them out downstream, soaked and furious.
>
> - **Fellmark.** *Read:* You're already moving before it tips all the way. You grab the rail and shove the raft flat again, and you catch one Shrewish by the back of the jumper with your other hand before he goes over. *Then:* One of the two ways is done. Their Reflex increases by 1.
> - **Success.** *Read:* You get a hand on the rail and haul it down flat. Everyone stays on. *Then:* One of the two ways is done.
> - **Failure.** *Read:* You grab and miss. Two of them go into the water. Dobb's crew fish them out further down the quay with poles, coughing and soaked and alive.
> - **Fellstrike.** *Read:* You grab and miss, and you go in after them. The river is cold enough to stop your breath, and fast, but it's shallow along the quay. You come up with a Shrewish in each hand. Dobb's crew pull all three of you out.

> [!readaloud] Dobb
> Dobb is standing at the edge of the quay with his paws at his sides, staring at the water. His mouth is moving, but no sound comes out of it. He was counting. He has stopped.

> [!lorecheck] Spirit: Steadying Dobb
> Any Fell who goes to him.
>
> - **Fellmark.** *Read:* You crouch down to his height and say his name, and then you start counting rafts for him, out loud, slowly. He picks it up after the third one. By the fifth his voice is his own again. He looks at you. "I can't swim," he says quietly. "Thirty years. Don't tell anybody." *Then:* Write down: Dobb held his nerve, and he told this Fell he can't swim. One of the two ways is done. Their Spirit increases by 1.
> - **Success.** *Read:* You talk him back to it. He picks up his pole, and after a moment he starts counting again. *Then:* Write down: Dobb held his nerve. One of the two ways is done.
> - **Failure.** *Read:* He nods at you and doesn't hear a word. *Then:* Write down: Dobb froze. He comes back to himself by the end of the scene, quieter.
> - **Fellstrike.** *Read:* You tell him to pull himself together. He flinches and sits down on the quay. *Then:* Write down: Dobb froze. His crew take over his counting for the rest of the night.

> [!readaloud] Closing: The rafts go out
> One by one the rafts push off from the steps, each one swinging round into the current and away downriver, its corner lamps getting smaller in the dark. On the quay, Kettle is sitting on top of a mooring post, shouting advice at every raft that leaves, most of it about not standing up.

> [!dialogue] Kettle
> "Sit down! Sit DOWN! Mister Hobb, you're standing! Everybody sit DOWN!"

> [!choice] Where the Fell go now
> - **To the shaft.** Go to [[05 - Down the Shaft|Down the Shaft]]. Nib is already down there.
> - **Stay on the quay.** The rafts keep going. Nobody is at the shaft, so the clock fills one segment at the end of this scene as usual, and again at the end of every scene they stay. Give them the choice again each time.
> - **Push off on a raft.** Let them. Read the off-the-page note in the overview.

> [!beat] Where everyone is now
> Say where each Fell is. At the end of this scene, if no Fell is at the shaft, fill one segment of the floor clock. Write down whether the loading is running and whether Dobb held his nerve.
